s: Shiur tallit ubo b' seipim: shiur tallit shechayyebet betzitzit, shiaru chakamim, im hi gedola kol kak sheqqatan shehiggia liklal chinnuk mitzvat tzitzit, dehaynu shehu ben tesha shanim, sheaz hu mithallek lebaddo bashshuq vetallito alayv, veen tzarik lishmor tallito shello yobad mimmennu, veim hu mitkasseh bah rosho verob orek gupo verob rochbo, vegadol ben y"g shanim hallobeshah eno mitbayyesh latzet bah beaqray lashshuq — hi niqret kesut vechayyebet betzitzit, veasur lehitlabbesh bah belo tzitzit apillu bebeto. Veim en haqqatan ben tesha shanim mitkasseh bah rosho verubbo, ap-al-pi shehaggadol ben y"g shanim yotze bah beaqray lashshuq — betela dato etzel kol adam, mippene sheenah niqret kesut kelal, velaken hi petura min hatztzitzit. Veyesh omerim sheim haqqatan ben tesha mitkasseh bah rosho verubbo, ap-al-pi sheen gadol ben y"g shanim yotze bah beaqray lashshuq — hi niqret kesut vechayyebet betzitzit. Vahalaka kassebara harishona, laken tzarik [lizzaher] shello laasot tallit qatan pachot mizzeh hashshiur shennitbaer lepi hassebara harishona. Veim rotzeh lehitlabbesh betallit shehi pechuta mizzeh hashshiur — yatil bah tzitzit, kede lachosh lassebara haacharona, abal lo yebarek aleha:
Yizzaharu laasot betallitot qetannim hakketepayim rechabim, dehaynu hachatikot hammuttalot al hakkatep, ki heki dela lete avira dehay gisa vaavira dehay gisa ulebattel leh:
